note: RV park within the 204-acre Masonic Park & Youth Camp near Wimauma, open to non-Masons; the RV area is separate from the youth camp but shares its lake and trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's RV page: $60 daily (weekly $360, monthly $550), over 110 full-hookup spaces, showers, free Wi-Fi, reservation by request form + deposit. Not stated: amps, rig length, pull-throughs, season.
flags: Price gate: base $60/night (operator's RV page, (c) 2025-26) is over US$50; the family has not stayed here and Wimauma is no gateway. No Good Sam discount on the entry.

Long-stay lean: monthly lot rental $550 against $60 a night (a month costs about nine nights) - the rate card is built for monthly guests; nights are sold only by request form with staff confirmation and deposit, no instant booking.
